original_question.question: Six identical coins touch in a triangular arrangement with rows of 3, 2 and 1, as shown. What is the smallest number of coins that must be moved to make the two-row parallelogram shown, with 3 coins in each row? In both arrangements, neighboring coins shown touching have centers one coin diameter apart. The coins may be lifted and placed freely, and a coin counts as moved if its center changes. The entire target arrangement may be translated and rotated, but not reflected or scaled; its position in the picture is only illustrative.
